name: What is the advantage of hiring a general contractor versus managing separate subcontractors myself?

mainEntity.name: What is the advantage of hiring a general contractor versus managing separate subcontractors myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor provides a single point of contact who manages scheduling, trade coordination, and quality control across every phase. Managing individual subcontractors yourself requires significant time to vet, schedule, and oversee separate crews for framing, plumbing, electrical, drywall, and finish carpentry. If one subcontractor delays, subsequent trades can fall out of alignment, increasing project downtime. At HH Remodeling LLC, our crew directly completes framing, drywall, tile, and painting while managing trusted plumbing and electrical specialists, eliminating the stress and scheduling conflicts homeowners face when trying to manage sub-trades alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor acts as your single point of contact, coordinating trades, managing timelines, and ensuring consistent build quality from framing to finish work.
